Name: Shaded Weapon
Description:
You weave together threads of shadow to create a weapon of solidified gloom in your hand, which lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals 2d8 psychic damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60). In addition, when you use the weapon to attack a target that is in dim light or darkness, you make the attack roll with advantage.

If you drop the weapon or throw it, it dissipates at the end of the turn. Thereafter, while the spell persists, you can use a bonus action to cause the weapon to reappear in your hand.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for every 2 slot levels above 2nd:
● The weapon deals an additional 1d8 psychic damage.
● You create a second shaded weapon in your other hand, which is identical to the first.
● The normal throwing range of the weapon increases by 30 feet, and its long range by 90 feet.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
